授業概要
本講義では，環境システムが連立偏微分方程式によりどのように記述されるか，そしてその連立偏微分方程式をどのよう数値的に解くかを取り扱う．
離散化手法として，有限差分法と有限体積法を取り扱う．
これらの手法における，微分項および流束の代表的な有限差分近似を，その精度評価手法とともに紹介する．
また対象とする系は主に、移流方程式や拡散方程式などの線形システムである．
In this lecture, we cover (1) how environmental systems are described by systems of partial differential equations and (2) how these equations are solved numerically.
In particular, the Finite Difference Method (FDM) and the Finite Volume Method (FVM) are introduced as discretization methods.
We also introduce several major finite difference approximations for derivatives and fluxes used in these methods, along with techniques for evaluating their accuracy.
In this lecture, we mainly deal with linear systems such as the advection equation and the diffusion equation.

全体の教育目標
To understand (1) how environmental systems are described by systems of partial differential equations and (2) how these equations are solved numerically.
個別の教育目標
(1) To derive a set of governing system equations. (2) To build a vector-matrix system equation of a system by discretizing system PDE in space and time. (3) To understand the characteristics of different types of spatial- and time- discretization methods. (4) To acquire how to evaluate the stability of the numerically represented system.
